page.title: Scheduled triggers
page.description: Lists the timed triggers in your published graphs. Each graph has two: one that runs it, one that reflects on it (reflection only proposes changes; it never edits the graph). A schedule only runs the version pinned at publish time; editing the draft changes nothing until you publish again.
page.utcNotice: Every timestamp is UTC. Slots missed while the process was down are never replayed.
page.empty: No schedules yet: add a scheduled (Cron) trigger node to a graph and publish it, and two rows appear here (run and reflect).

actions.running: Started one run at v{{version}} (it does not consume a scheduled slot)
actions.reflected: Ran one reflection pass ({{status}}; proposals only, no scheduled slot consumed)
actions.toggleFailed: The switch did not take effect

cron.hint: Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, evaluated in UTC. Supports *, */n, a-b, a-b/n and comma lists; 7 means Sunday.
cron.unavailable: Preview unavailable (the check could not reach the server) — saving still validates the expression.
